title: Salman Khan responds to Maatrubhumi trailer criticism; tells audience not to judge the film by its five-minute trailer
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The star addressed complaints about the trailer’s runtime and claims that it revealed too much of the storyline, asking audiences to wait until the movie’s December 4 rollout.

Adding to this, Since the trailer was rolled out earlier this month, its runtime and the amount of story it appeared to reveal have become talking points among a section of social media users. Responding to the comments with his trademark humour, Salman shared that the complete movie would be available for audiences to watch on December 4.

Meanwhile, Addressing the criticism, he shared, “Trailer bahut lamba hai.. poori picture dikha di. Nahi Bhai, Poori picture main aapko dikhaunga December 4 ko. Kya bolte hai – Never judge a book by its cover. Aapne cover se hi book ko judge kar liya. Ab jab yeh ulta padega tabhi kya hoga (The trailer is too long... they have shown the entire movie. No brother, I will show you the entire movie on December 4. What do they say – Never judge a book by its cover. You have already judged the book by its cover itself. Now, what will happen when this backfires)?”

Notably, The star also took a playful dig at those who had repeatedly watched the trailer to analyse its scenes and identify details about the plot. Suggesting that the full-length movie would give them considerably more to discuss, he added, “Aapko paanch minute ke trailer mein, itne baar dekh ke, itne saare points nikaalne pade, ab dhai ghante ke movie mein kitne baar dekhoge picture aap (In a five-minute trailer, after watching it so many times, you had to pick out so many points; now in a two-and-a-half-hour movie, how many times will you watch the movie)...”
As per the latest buzz, A post shared by Bollywood Hungama🎥 (@realbollywoodhungama)

In further updates, Directed by Apoorva Lakhia, Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace is a war drama featuring Salman Khan and Chitrangda Singh together for the first time. Produced under the banner of Salman Khan Films, the movie is scheduled for a nationwide theatrical rollout on December 4, 2026.

title: Salman Khan confirms Dabangg sequel is in the works, rules out Bajrangi Bhaijaan 2: “I don’t think it is possible”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The star discussed the future of both franchises, explaining why he does not want a follow-up to the 2015 movie to be compared unfavourably with the original.

Adding to this, Asked about the future of Dabangg , which introduced audiences to the much-loved character of Chulbul Pandey in 2010, Salman suggested that the decision to take the franchise forward remains within his family’s control. The movie spawned two sequels, rolled out in 2012 and 2019, respectively.

Meanwhile, Sharing an update, the star shared, “ Dabangg ka toh aa hi jaayega. Yeh toh humare haath mein hai. Baaki films unke haath mein hai (A Dabangg sequel will definitely happen. That is in our hands. The rest of the films are in their hands).”

Notably, However, his response was markedly different when he was asked about Bajrangi Bhaijaan 2 . Salman explained that he does not believe another movie could match the emotional connect of the original and would rather not risk audiences comparing the two films unfavourably. The 2015 movie, directed by Kabir Khan, featured Salman as Pawan Kumar Chaturvedi, a man who helps a young Pakistani girl reunite with her family.
As per the latest buzz, #BajrangiBhaijaan sequel nahi aayega. Usse better movie banana possible nahi.
In further updates, #SalmanKhan on sequels of #BB #Kick at ABP conclave. https://t.co/DuZG9Dxq3d

On top of that, Elaborating on his position, Salman shared, “ Bajrangi ka aisa hai ke Bajrangi ke upar koi movie jaana, I don’t think it is possible – emotionally and its connect. Toh woh karna hi nahi jahan par yeh second movie first movie se compare hue aur bole ki yaar ismein mazaa nahi aaya. So yaa, I don’t think Bajrangi Bhaijaan (sequel) banegi (The thing with Bajrangi is that for any movie to surpass Bajrangi , I don’t think it is possible – emotionally and its connect. So, I don’t want to do something where the second movie gets compared to the first movie and people say, 'It wasn’t as enjoyable.' So yeah, I don’t think a Bajrangi Bhaijaan sequel will be made).”

For now, Salman’s next theatrical outing is Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace . Directed by Apoorva Lakhia, the patriotic drama also stars Chitrangada Singh and is scheduled to rollout in theatres on December 4, 2026.

title: Madhur Bhandarkar says Dhurandhar was the right choice for Indian Panorama opening film at IFFI
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Madhur Bhandarkar says the selection of Dhurandhar for IFFI was an unanimous choice. more What Madhur shared The filmmaker, who is chairperson of the jury for the Indian Panorama section, shared the decision was taken collectively by him and the other jury members. "The way it has been shot, the way it has been made, and being a popular movie, it's a very commercial smash hit movie. People have loved it, people have loved the songs also, and performance-wise also, Ranveer Singh, everybody acted so well," he shared.

Adding to this, "I thought that this movie has to be the opening movie. It's a big movie, and everybody has loved it. People, I know, have watched the movie two, three times. So I thought that was the right movie, and that's the reason Dhurandhar was the movie," he shared.

Meanwhile, Speaking about his association with IFFI, Bhandarkar shared he has been connected with the festival in different capacities over the years, including as a member of its steering committee, a jury chairperson and as a filmmaker whose films have been showcased there. He recalled that his films such as Page 3, Corporate, Chandni Bar and India Lockdown had been screened at the festival.

Notably, The Indian Panorama Section is one of IFFI’s flagship sections and includes the best of Indian cinema, with a special focus on films outside the mainstream and from regional languages and cultures otherwise hidden from the mainstream.
As per the latest buzz, The section includes 25 feature length films and 20 non-feature films.

In further updates, Dhurandhar tells the story of Jaskirat Singh Rangi, alias Hamza Ali Mazari, sent to Lyari in Pakistan to bring down a terror unit. He infiltrates a Baloch gang, marries the daughter of a Lyari politician and integrates into the society there to do this.

On top of that, The first movie was rolled out in theatres on December 5, 2025, and Dhurandhar 2 on March 19 this year. Ranveer, Akshaye Khanna , Sanjay Dutt, Arjun Rampal, R Madhavan, Sara Arjun, Rakesh Bedi, Gaurav Gera, and Danish Pandor star in the two films. The first movie collected ₹ 1307 crore rupees worldwide, while the sequel grossed ₹ 1790 crore rupees. Together, the two films have crossed the ₹ 3,000-crore rupees mark globally.

title: Amit Shah reaches out to Siang dam protesters in Arunachal, says concerns will be resolved through dialogue
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Union Home Minister Amit Shah will be in the city on November 15 and 16. (File photo) more Speaking at an event in Itanagar, Shah shared the 11,200-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project (SUMP) will play a pivotal role in the development of the country and the state. He added that he was aware of the apprehensions of people over the project and had come to Arunachal Pradesh to address their concerns directly.

Adding to this, “I want to make it clear to my brothers and sisters of Siang that the government will hold discussions with the people. We will take you into confidence, and only through dialogue will the road ahead be paved. There is no need to worry,” he shared at a ceremony held to confer the President’s Colour on the Arunachal Pradesh Police.

Meanwhile, Shah’s remarks after protests against the proposed power project turned violent in East Siang district, with demonstrators torching the office of a PSU, setting fire to a police station, vandalising the residences of three political leaders and injuring police personnel in October. The violence followed a 12-hour bandh on and came a day after four people were injured when police fired tear gas shells to disperse protesters. Chief minister Pema Khandu condemned the clashes and urged protesters to pursue their demands through peaceful and democratic means.

Notably, Opposition to the project stems from fears that the dam could displace local communities, damage the fragile ecosystem and submerge ancestral lands. The central and state governments, however, consider the project a strategic safeguard against China’s massive hydropower development upstream in Tibet.

As per the latest buzz, “The government and I have the same respect you have for the local culture. We will move forward without compromising the traditions, culture and religion of this place,” Shah shared, stressing that any future decision on the project will be taken by taking the local residents along.

In further updates, On Friday, the Adi Ba:né Kébang United (ABKU), an outfit representing the Adi community, and the Siang Indigenous Farmers’ Forum (SIFF), submitted a joint memorandum to Shah, demanding an immediate halt to pre-feasibility activities, the rollout of detained protesters, the withdrawal of security forces and a judicial inquiry into the October 23 violence in Siang district.

On top of that, Shah also promised “one of the country’s best” rehabilitation and resettlement packages for people who could be affected by the proposed dam. Appealing to organisations and residents opposing the project, he urged them to engage with the state government, which could facilitate further discussions with the Union home ministry.
There was no immediate reaction to the groups opposing the project to Shah’s statements.

title: EXCLUSIVE: Huma Qureshi-starrer Bayaan to have a direct-to-digital release on Zee 5
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

A trade source told Bollywood Hungama , “ Bayaan will skip a theatrical rollout and premiere directly on OTT. Zee 5 has picked up the rights to the movie. They were impressed with the movie’s subject, realism and performances and felt that the movie has immense potential to appeal to a wide section of the audience. It is now expected to drop either in December 2026 or January 2027.”

Adding to this, Bollywood Hungama has further learned that the movie has secured a censor certificate from the Central Board of Movie Certification (CBFC). The source added, “ Bayaan has been passed with a U/A 16+ certificate, which means that the movie is not restricted to adult audiences.”

Meanwhile, Apart from headlining Bayaan , Huma Qureshi is also associated with the movie as an executive producer. It is directed by Bikas Ranjan Mishra and produced by Shiladitya Bora’s Platoon One Films, Summit Studios and Guidant Films. In September 2025, it was screened at the 50th Toronto International Movie Festival (TIFF), alongside Neeraj Ghaywan’s Homebound (2025) and Anurag Kashyap's Bobby Deol-starrer Bandar (2026), among others.

Notably, In Bayaan , Huma Qureshi plays a rookie police officer in Rajasthan who investigates a case involving a ‘Maharaj’, or a cult leader, accused of raping numerous girls at his ashram. However, the godman wields considerable power and enjoys influence over both the police and the political establishment. How the police officer battles the odds to secure a 'bayaan' , or testimony, that can put the cult leader behind bars forms the crux of the movie.

As per the latest buzz, Besides Huma Qureshi, Bayaan also stars Chandrachur Singh, Sachin Khedekar, Vibhore Mayank, Swati Das and Sampa Mandal. Interestingly, in January 2026, Bollywood Hungama had opened up that Chandrachur Singh essays the role of a corrupt godman in the movie.

title: Salman Khan feels ‘really bad’ about Maatrubhumi's clash with Eetha, apologised to Shraddha Kapoor on call
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Speaking at a summit hosted in Hyderabad by ABP, Salman shared he felt bad about the situation and would not have chosen the same date had he been aware of Eetha's rollout. "So when we revealed the 4th (of December), I did not know that Shraddha was coming out on the 4th of December. I feel really, really bad about it. If I would've known, I would not have come out with Shraddha. I spoke to her. I called her up. I mean, I've seen them grow up. I spoke to her and shared, 'I'm really sorry, I didn't know," he shared.

Adding to this, According to Salman, Shraddha was gracious about the situation and reassured him that there was room for both films at the ticket-window. "No, no, sir. There's enough space for both of our films to come," she told him. Salman replied, “Very good, I'm happy”.

Meanwhile, He also encouraged audiences to watch Eetha, making a point of cheering for the movie during a public appearance. "I do think that everyone should go and see that movie," he shared. He had previously also shared Eetha's poster on his Instagram Story with a message for the team: "All the best for Eetha".

Notably, Salman also explained why Maatrubhumi 's rollout date kept changing. The movie was earlier being considered for November 20 and November 27, before the makers settled on December 4. He shared the team needed more time after he noticed issues with the visual effects during a screening.

As per the latest buzz, Directed by Apoorva Lakhia, Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace is produced by Salma Khan under the banner of Salman Khan Films. The movie features Salman Khan and Chitrangda Singh in key roles and is inspired by the 2020 Galwan Valley conflict. Salman plays an Army officer in the war drama. The movie has received a U/A 16+ certificate from the CBFC and has a runtine of around two hours and 34 minutes.

In further updates, Eetha is based on the life of Vithabai Narayangaonkar, a well-known name in the world of Lavani and Tamasha. Directed by Laxman Utekar, the movie features Shraddha Kapoor, Randeep Hooda, Mohammed Zeeshan Ayyub and Siddharth Jadhav. It is produced by Dinesh Vijan and Laxman Utekar under Maddock Films and Kathputli Creations, with music by Ajay-Atul.
On top of that, Both Eetha and Maatrubhumi are scheduled to hit theatres worldwide on December 4, 2026.

title: Makers of Sanjay Kapoor-starrer 'Unexpected - Safed Sach' release first look poster of the film
body: Here's the latest fashion moment turning heads:

Makers of Sanjay Kapoor-starrer 'Unexpected - Safed Sach' rollout first look poster of the movie more The movie revolves around Dehradun's ISBT rape incident, which took place in 2024 as a minor girl was allegedly gang-raped inside a roadways bus at the Inter-State Bus Terminal . Actors Prashant Narayanan and Esther Anil also feature alongside Kapoor, according to a press rollout.
Adding to this, It is directed by Anji and explores the complexities of an investigation and the challenges faced by law enforcement in uncovering the truth behind a sensitive case.

Meanwhile, Kapoor shared featuring in the movie has been a "meaningful experience" for him. "What makes this movie important is its connection with a sensitive real-life subject. Incidents involving women's safety are not just headlines; they remind us of our collective responsibility as a society," he shared in a note.

Notably, "Through my character, we hope to highlight the importance of a thorough investigation and the pursuit of truth. I think cinema can play an important role in bringing such issues into public conversation," he added.

As per the latest buzz, The star also shared the post on his Instagram handle on Saturday, which featured the poster of the movie with Kapoor, Narayanan, Anil on it. "Behind every quiet face on this poster is the weight of that one fateful night. Yash Veera Films presents the official poster of 'UNEXPECTED ' - a true incident.
In further updates, Narayanan shared the movie "deals with a subject which is both sensitive and socially relevant".

On top of that, "Stories on real incidents carry a certain responsibility, and as actors, it is important for us to approach such narratives with honesty and conviction. I was drawn to the movie because of its gripping storyline and the larger message it tries to convey," he added.
The movie is being made in nine languages - Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Garhwali, Gujarati, Punjabi and Bhojpuri. It will have music composed by Kevin Roy.

title: Salman Khan says there's ‘no way’ Maatrubhumi would clash with Shah Rukh Khan and Suhana's King; okay to face off Avengers Doomsday, Dune 3
body: Here's the latest update from the Hollywood/Marvel world:

At a summit hosted by ABP in Hyderabad, Salman talked about Maatrubhumi after promoting the movie in the city. Explaining why he picked its rollout date, he added, “ Shah Rukh is coming on December 24. I am not going to clash with Shah Rukh and his daughter, Suhana. No way. Now, these two films that are releasing, Avengers and Dune, I will clash with them anytime. But they’re coming out a week before. I don’t have a problem clashing with them at all. Now, if I leave my rollout date, Shah Rukh’s movie comes out one week later. Never wanna clash.”

Adding to this, He also pondered how he could pick a date early next year, but why he didn’t want to do that. “Then, there’s January 26, it’s a good date. Sanjay Leela Bhansali is coming with Vicky, Ranbir and Alia. So, I didn’t want to clash with them either. Now, next week after that, again a good date, but then there’s another movie coming out in March. And that’s Monster. And I don’t want to clash with myself,” added Salman as the audience burst out laughing.

Meanwhile, Maatrubhumi will now clash with Laxman Utekar’s Shraddha Kapoor-starrer Eetha , and the star had ‘three cheers’ for it. Avengers: Doomsday is releasing on December 17 and Dune 3 on December 18.

Notably, Maatrubhumi is directed by Apoorva Lakhia and produced by Salman Khan under his Salman Khan Films banner. Chitrangada Singh, Anoop Bikram Shahi and Prashant Tamang also star in it. The movie was initially titled Battle of Galwan, but the title was changed, and it underwent a rehaul. At a promotional event, Salman admitted that Apoorva had a different story .

As per the latest buzz, Addressing criticism for the movie’s promotional material in Hyderabad, Salman shared, “Our movie is about the country’s soldiers and their families. And instead of that, you talk about VFX and AI. Who are these people? Where do they come from?” He also added, “Are these people AI specialists? Are they VFX specialists? They think it does not look like Salman Khan shot this scene; it must be someone else. So, for your knowledge, let me tell you that I might not see all this, but my team does.”

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The association has urged the Maharashtra government and Mumbai Police to step up protection for movie personalities and shooting locations.

Adding to this, In a statement shared on X (formerly Twitter), the association expressed concern over the reported threats directed at actors Saif Ali Khan, Amitabh Bachchan and Abhishek Bachchan. These include enhanced security for Saif Ali Khan, Amitabh Bachchan, Abhishek Bachchan and their families; safety measures for movie personalities and filmmakers across Mumbai; adequate police protection at shooting locations; strict action against gangsters and their networks; and close monitoring of press conferences and public events involving movie personalities.

title: Ramayana box office collection Day 16: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash film crosses ₹875 crore, becomes second-fastest to cross ₹650 crore in Hindi
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Ranbir Kapoor, Yash's movie has crossed ₹870 crore rupees at the ticket-window. more Ramayana ticket-window earnings According to Sacnilk, Ramayana collected ₹ 13.27 crore rupees on Friday, Day 16, taking its total India net collection to ₹ 877.02 crore rupees. Its overall occupancy stood at around 20%. On Thursday, the movie collected ₹ 19.35 crore rupees, but collections dropped on Friday.

Adding to this, The movie opened in theatres with ₹ 64.85 crore rupees on November 5. It witnessed an unprecedented jump during the Diwali holidays, collecting ₹ 107.50 crore rupees on November 9, a day after Diwali. After its first eight days in theatres, Ramayana had collected ₹ 564.60 crore rupees at the domestic ticket-window. The movie continued its strong run in the second week, earning ₹ 299.15 crore rupees between Days 9 and 15.

Meanwhile, Ramayana has also achieved a major milestone in the Hindi ticket-window. The movie crossed the ₹ 650-crore rupees mark in Hindi net collections in 15 days, becoming the second-fastest movie to achieve the feat. It is behind Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge, which reached the milestone in just nine days.

Notably, The movie has beaten Pushpa 2, which took 17 days to cross the ₹ 650-crore rupees mark in Hindi, while Dhurandhar achieved the feat in 23 days. Ramayana has thus joined the list of the fastest Hindi films to reach the milestone.

As per the latest buzz, Taran Adarsh noted that Ramayana has no major competition at the ticket-window for now and is expected to enjoy a good run for another week. However, the movie will face competition from Yeh Prem Mol Liya and Gunmaaster G9 when they rollout on November 27. He wrote, "#Ramayana [#Hindi version] posts a sensational total in Week 2, following a phenomenal run in its extended Week 1… The movie is expected to continue its dominance at the boxoffice this week as well – making it three consecutive weeks without any major opposition. #Ramayana will face competition from #YehPremMolLiya and #GunmaasterG9 next Friday [27 Nov 2026], when its screens, shows, and footfalls will be divided."

In further updates, Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana. The movie is produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash. It's second part is scheduled to rollout in 2028.

title: EXCLUSIVE: Sanjay Kapoor, Prashant Narayanan and Esther Anil to star in crime thriller UNEXPECTED – SAFED SACH, first-look poster unveiled
body: Here's the latest fashion moment turning heads:

Presented by YASH VEERA FILMS and produced by Pyarelal Gundecha (Sojat Road Wala), the movie is directed and shot by 'Garudavega' Anji. The project also features Prithvi Raj, Thambi Ramaiah, Sanjay Singh and Ganja Karuppu in significant roles.

Adding to this, Sanjay Kapoor will be seen playing SSP Bharat Singh, an investigating police officer entrusted with probing a case connected to Dehradun's Inter-State Bus Terminal (ISBT). The movie's narrative revolves around the disappearance of a teenage girl following a misunderstanding at home, which is triggered by a planted love letter. Matters take a serious turn when she boards a night bus from Dehradun ISBT and subsequently goes missing.

Meanwhile, The discovery of an abandoned bus and the girl's subsequent admission to a government hospital in an unconscious state lead to a police investigation. As the authorities attempt to piece together the circumstances surrounding the incident, several unanswered questions emerge. Through this storyline, the movie explores the complexities of police investigations and the challenges law enforcement agencies face while uncovering the truth in sensitive cases.
Notably, Prashant Narayanan, known for his performances in films such as Murder 2 , Bhag Johnny and Dharam Sankat Mein , also plays a significant role in the investigative thriller.

As per the latest buzz, Speaking about his character, Sanjay Kapoor says, “Playing an investigating police officer in UNEXPECTED – SAFED SACH has been a meaningful experience. What makes this movie important is its connection with a sensitive real-life subject. Incidents involving women’s safety are not just headlines; they remind us of our collective responsibility as a society. Through my character, we hope to highlight the importance of a thorough investigation and the pursuit of truth. I believe cinema can play an important role in bringing such issues into public conversation.”

In further updates, Prashant Narayanan also spoke about his association with the project, stating, “UNEXPECTED – SAFED SACH deals with a subject that is both sensitive and socially relevant. Stories inspired by real incidents carry a certain responsibility, and as actors, it is important for us to approach such narratives with honesty and conviction. I was drawn to the movie because of its gripping storyline and the larger message it seeks to convey. I hope audiences connect with the movie and the questions it raises.”

On top of that, Producer Pyarelal Gundecha (Sojat Road Wala) highlighted the intention behind bringing the story to the screen. He shared, “As a producer, I believe cinema has the power to entertain while also bringing important social issues into the spotlight. With UNEXPECTED – SAFED SACH, our intention is to present a compelling story inspired by real incidents and highlight the importance of women’s safety, justice and responsible policing. We have brought together a talented cast and technical team to create a movie that resonates with audiences across the country. I hope the movie encourages meaningful conversations while delivering a powerful cinematic experience.”

Director and cinematographer 'Garudavega' Anji also shared his perspective on the project, saying, “UNEXPECTED – SAFED SACH goes beyond conventional crime-thriller storytelling. Inspired by real incidents, the movie aims to initiate conversations around women’s safety, public responsibility and the importance of understanding the consequences of situations that can change lives. Our intention is to present an engaging cinematic experience while addressing a subject that deserves wider attention.”

title: Party Animals review: Nothing really gets the party going in this Viraj Ghelani-Alam Khan buddy comedy
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Party Animals, directed by Ravi Chhabriya, tries too hard to be funny. more Party Animals story Directed by Ravi Chhabriya, the story revolves around Mann (Viraj Ghelani), who throws a grand party in Mumbai in the hopes of proposing to the girl he likes. He insists that his childhood friend, Armaan Khanna (Arjun Tanwar), who is gearing up for his movie debut, also attend the bash. Sohail (Saqib Ayub) and Danish (Alam Khan) help Mann with the arrangements, but their own personal troubles, coupled with the party spiralling out of control, form the crux of the story.

Adding to this, The biggest problem here is that the movie tries far too hard to be funny. Written by Ali Haji, Khushi Mullick and Veer Panchal, it begins by establishing the bond between Mann and Armaan during their school days before transitioning to their adult lives. The first half is largely about setting the stage, introducing its crazy characters. Its collaboration with music label Sa Re Ga Ma (also produced by the label under its production house) also results in several old classics being rehashed, including Aa Dekhein Zara and Raat Baaki Baat Baaki. None of this is particularly bad, but it's not particularly entertaining either.

Meanwhile, Very little actually lands. The humour is bland, and the movie's attempt to replicate Kunal Kemmu 's brand of comedy, seen in films such as Madgaon Express, is evident. Yet, unlike those films, Party Animals doesn't have enough sharp writing or genuinely funny situations to make its chaos work.

Notably, The second half drags a little, with a romantic track running parallel to the main plot. By the time the movie reaches its climax, you realise that the party itself, which was supposed to be the movie's central attraction, has taken a backseat. Instead of watching a celebration spiral into chaos, you find yourself spending more time on distractions that do little to advance the story.

As per the latest buzz, Performance-wise, Arjun Tanwar, playing the star kid, delivers a decent performance, while Alam Khan is effective in his role. Viraj Ghelani is a natural and fits the character of Mann quite well. He brings an easygoing vibe to the role, but the material simply doesn't do enough to complement his efforts. The cast is game, but the writing leaves them with very little to work with. Pragati Nagpal as Zara is good. Kamlesh Sawant and Vijay Patkar are wasted in their roles as the sympathetic cops.

In further updates, Overall, Party Animals wants to be a wild ride fuelled by friendship and misadventures, but there is very little here that genuinely gets the party going. The jokes rarely land, and the story takes unnecessary detours. The cast brings some energy to the proceedings, but the writing lets them down. For all the cussing and late-night revelry, Party Animals is missing the one thing a party should never be short of: fun.

On top of that, Rishabh Suri is an Assistant Editor, movie critic, and professional overthinker of plot points. He writes for HT City, keeping pace with an industry where news cycles expire long before the popcorn gets cold. He completed his graduation in English Honours from Kirori Mal College, followed by a Master’s degree in English Literature-effectively training his brain to over-analyse classic texts before applying those exact same skills to 3-hour Bollywood blockbusters. He got into the profession when he had barely graduated from college and has been at HT ever since. At HT, Rishabh reviews films with a simple rule: skip the dense academic jargon and get straight to the point. Beyond reviews, as Assistant Editor, he helps navigate the broader circus of showbiz, tracking everything from OTT shifts to sudden ticket-window panics. In a beat driven by loud PR machinery and carefully scripted answers, Rishabh prefers cutting through the noise to focus on how stories get made and why trends shift. When he isn’t writing against a deadline, he is usually sitting in a dark theater, compulsively memorising dialogues. For Rishabh, analysing movies isn't just a day job- it’s a habit he couldn't turn off even if he tried.

title: India declines comment on Tarique Rahman’s ‘across the border’ jibe over Bangladesh unrest
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

India on Friday refused to be drawn on Bangladesh Prime Minister Tarique Rahman’s accusation that protests by the Awami League were being directed by masters “across the border” and reiterated its long-standing position that it desires positive and constructive ties with the neighbouring country.

Adding to this, When external affairs ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal was asked about Rahman’s remarks, he replied: “I have no comments to make on the internal developments in Bangladesh.” Parts of Bangladesh witnessed violence on Thursday as members of the party of former premier Sheikh Hasina attempted to bring businesses and public transport to a halt. The Awami League called a nationwide lockdown on Thursday at the end of a week-long campaign of protests against the government’s rejection of Hasina’s request for a new passport to enable her to return home from India, where she has lived in self-exile since August 2024.

Meanwhile, When external affairs ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal was asked about Rahman’s remarks blaming the unrest on India and Awami League leaders based in the neighbouring country, he replied: “I have no comments to make on the internal developments in Bangladesh.”

Notably, While addressing a public event at Lalmonirhat in northern Bangladesh on Thursday, Rahman shared Awami League leaders “have not looked at ​the interests of Bangladesh and its people”. Without naming India, he added, “At the same time, the country across the border, where they have fled to, is their master…To ​satisfy those masters, they have again started conspiring against Bangladesh and its people.”

As per the latest buzz, The lockdown called by the Awami League was successful mostly in southern areas where the party has a strong presence. Police shared two members of the ruling Bangladesh Nationalist Party were killed on Wednesday night, and the houses of two BNP lawmakers in Hasina’s home district of Gopalganj were vandalised.

In further updates, Jaiswal repeated India’s long-standing stance on ties with Bangladesh, telling a regular media briefing: “Our position remains consistent — that India desires a positive, constructive and forward-looking relationship with Bangladesh, one which is rooted in the shared histories of the two countries and in their shared cultural ties of their peoples.”

On top of that, Hasina’s London-based lawyers sent a second request seeking a passport and a national identity card for her to the Bangladesh high commission on Thursday. Hasina first sought a passport in connection with her planned homecoming earlier this month, but this was rejected by officials in Dhaka, who reiterated Bangladesh’s request for her extradition.
Jaiswal shared he had “no update” on the extradition issue. In the past, he has shared the extradition request is a legal matter and will be dealt with accordingly.

title: Cine workers' body writes to Maharashtra CM requesting stronger security for Saif Ali Khan, Amitabh Bachchan after threats
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Saif Ali Khan and Amitabh Bachchan of late received threats from gangsters. more Cine workers’ body’s letter to the CM AICWA president Suresh Shyamlal Gupta wrote to the CM and sent a copy to Mumbai police commissioner Deven Bharti seeking urgent protection for Bollywood. Mentioning that gangsters have openly threatened several actors in the last few weeks, claiming to have 200 shooters at their disposal, the workers’ body pointed out that if the situation continues, it will begin to affect movie shoots.

Adding to this, “The livelihood of lakhs of workers, technicians, artists and set workers is now at risk. If this continues, a lock will fall on Bollywood: shootings will stop completely, workers will lose their jobs and producers will suffer heavy losses,” read a portion of the letter, adding, “Bollywood contributes significantly to the nation's revenue and carries India's name across the world. Every such incident damages that reputation. Because movie personalities are visible and seen as soft targets, gangsters attack them for publicity and extortion.”

Meanwhile, Stating that it feels like Bollywood is back in the 1990s under the underworld's grip, the AICWA put forth five demands to protect the movie industry. “Stronger security for Saif Ali Khan, Shri Amitabh Bachchan, Abhishek Bachchan and their families. Safety for all movie personalities and filmmakers in Mumbai. Adequate police protection at all shooting locations,” read a few of their demands.

Notably, The others read, “Strict action against gangsters and their networks, and a gangster-free Mumbai. Close monitoring of press conferences and public events involving movie personalities.” The workers’ body also wrote: “Bollywood must be able to move freely on Mumbai's streets, shoot and work without fear.”

As per the latest buzz, This comes after Mumbai Police told news agency PTI on Thursday that they have started an investigation into the alleged death threat received by Saif and are verifying its authenticity. “Star Saif Ali Khan received a voice message on his phone in the name of Zeeshan Akhtar, stating that he would meet the same fate as Baba Siddique,” a police official was quoted as saying.

In further updates, Amitabh Bachchan , Ayushmann Khurrana, Diljit Dosanjh, and Tusshar Kapoor also received similar threats in recent weeks. Tiger was shot at in Juhu in October, and he escaped unharmed. His driver and a bystander sustained bullet wounds. Salman Khan is also no stranger to constant threats from Lawrence Bishnoi and his gang over an alleged blackbuck poaching case.

On top of that, Despite having a Master's degree in Journalism and over a decade of experience in print and digital media as a field reporter and sub-editor at organisations such as The Times of India and Reader's Digest, Neeshita Nyayapati remains a movie buff first and a Chief Content Producer second. She fell in love with movies in childhood and believes nothing matches the magic of watching a good movie that moves you with a warm tub of popcorn in hand. Her love for writing about cinema follows that. Come Friday, you'll find her at her happy place, the movies, catching the latest rom-com or masala offering, for reviews or otherwise. As for the rest of the week, she's here reporting the juiciest news in Telugu, Tamil, Malayalam, Kannada and Hindi or bringing out the best of celebs in interviews. While her niche is Telugu cinema, Neeshita likes to dabble in a little bit of everything to stay up to date. From movie announcements to scandals and hard news angles, she has explored it all. A good book, a comforting cup of hot chocolate, puppy kisses and a stunning beach view are all she needs to unwind. Her passion for biking and travelling has taken her to various places across the country. She has found peace in everything from the frozen lakes of Gangtok to the coffee plantations of Coorg and the dense forests of Bandipur, to the monasteries of Darjeeling. But no matter where she goes, Neeshita loves coming across inspiring and moving stories.

title: Darsheel Safary and Zain Khan Durrani team up for Alok Naik's cybercrime thriller Cyber
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Cyber follows two unemployed computer engineering graduates who get an opportunity to work with a cyber agency. What initially appears to be a chance to put their technical knowledge and abilities to use soon takes them into the complicated world of cybercrime and investigations. As they navigate their new responsibilities, the two find themselves dealing with situations that bring unexpected changes to their lives.

Adding to this, Beyond its crime-based narrative, the movie also focuses on unemployment, personal aspirations and the struggles of young individuals trying to establish themselves. Through the journeys of its central characters, Cyber looks at the challenges faced by two graduates as they search for opportunities and a sense of purpose.

Meanwhile, The movie is produced by Raj Zacharias under the banner of Celebs and Red Carpet. The production house has previously backed several South Indian films, including Anwar , starring Prithviraj, Lalbagh and Rahadari , among others. With Cyber , the production banner is making its debut in Hindi cinema.

Notably, Alongside Darsheel Safary and Zain Khan Durrani, the movie features an ensemble cast comprising Ajit Koshy, Kabir Duhan Singh, Prasad Oak, Alisha Khan, Ayushi Tyagi, Soumya Srivastav, Rahul Singh and Vitthal Kale.

As per the latest buzz, Talking about the reason behind backing the project, producer Raj Zacharias shared, "What attracted me to this was it's a story of two engineering graduates who are jobless and trying to do something in life. It's a common man's story. It's a pure, raw and realistic storyline about how they get a chance to work with a cyber agency and how their life changes."

In further updates, The movie's music has been composed by award-winning musician Gopi Sundar CS, who is known for his work in films such as Geetha Govindam , Bangalore Days and Charlie . He has also contributed to several projects across Malayalam, Telugu and Tamil cinema.

On top of that, With a storyline centred on cybercrime and the realities of unemployment, Cyber brings together a contemporary subject, investigative elements and the experiences of two young graduates. The movie marks a new collaboration between Darsheel Safary and Zain Khan Durrani, while also introducing the production banner to Hindi cinema.'

title: Western Railway halts demolition in Mumbai's Prabhadevi amid protest
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Western Railway (WR) revealed on Friday that it was putting on hold the planned demolition of 102 unauthorised structures on railway land near the western side of Mumbai's Prabhadevi railway station.

Adding to this, UBT Sena MLA Ajay Chaudhary shared the WR general manager sent a message to MNS leader Bala Nandgaonkar, informing him that the demolition drive had been stopped. (PTI | Representational image) In a statement, the Western Railway shared that the demolition of encroachments has been temporarily postponed and that a comprehensive policy will be formulated.

Meanwhile, "The issue involves a substantial extent of encroachment on railway land and requires a comprehensive and permanent solution. The railway administration, in coordination with the state government, is working towards formulating a long-term policy framework to address the issue in a sustainable manner. Accordingly, further action at the site will be taken after the policy-level solution is finalised," the media statement read.
Notably, UBT Sena MLA Ajay Chaudhary shared WR general manager sent a message to MNS leader Bala Nandgaonkar, informing him that the demolition drive had been stopped.

As per the latest buzz, Former Shiv Sena corporator Samadhan Sarvankar shared the decision came after Maharashtra deputy chief Minister Eknath Shinde spoke to Union railway minister Ashwini Vaishnaw on Friday morning amid legal intervention and protests by residents. Shinde also holds the urban development portfolio.

In further updates, “We sent the videos of the protest to Shinde Saheb. The slum dwellers are not getting alternative accommodation. This is not correct. Seeing the protest, Shinde spoke to Ashwini Vaishnaw and got the demolition stopped. Slum dwellers can be moved only after the alternate accommodation is given,” he shared.

On top of that, Residents staged a protest by sitting and lying in front of the JCB machinery, forcing officials to stop the operation. The demolition drive aimed to clear two chawls and several ground-floor and one-floor rooms to make way for residential quarters for railway employees.
The eviction action, originally scheduled for Thursday, could not proceed after the affected residents approached the Bombay high court.

title: IFFI gives documentaries a bigger screen, rolls out red carpet for MIFF winners
body: Here's the latest fashion moment turning heads:

Panaji, The International Movie Festival of India has added a dedicated documentary section and a special showcase for Mumbai International Movie Festival award winners to broaden opportunities for non-fiction filmmakers, festival director Ashutosh Gowariker shared on Friday.

Adding to this, IFFI gives documentaries a bigger screen, rolls out red carpet for MIFF winners Addressing a press conference ahead of the eight-day festival's opening here, Gowariker shared the move aims to ensure documentary makers have two major showcase opportunities each year alongside new categories for animation and docudramas.

Meanwhile, "MIFF is an important festival of ours, which focuses only on documentaries and short films. But documentaries are being made much more, and we want to allow documentary filmmakers to have two festivals in a year," he shared.
Notably, He added that filmmakers would have an opportunity to showcase their works if they missed either of these festivals.
As per the latest buzz, IFFI has also organised a special gala for MIFF award winners, where their films will be showcased in a 90-minute presentation.
In further updates, Gowariker shared the gala would provide a red-carpet platform to recognise and celebrate filmmakers whose works received awards at MIFF.

On top of that, The theme of this year's IFFI, 'Stories Without Borders', has been chosen against the backdrop of conflicts across the world and social divisions within societies, the filmmaker shared.
He explained that the theme goes beyond geographical boundaries and addresses divisions within families, between communities and those arising from caste, religion and other socio-cultural factors.

title: Ananya Panday says younger generation still seeks true love, but won't settle down as standards are 'very high' now
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Ananya Panday was one of the speakers at the 24th edition of the Hindustan Times Leadership Summit 2026 , where she spoke about her career, Bollywood today and more. During her conversation with Sonal Kalra, Chief Managing Editor, Entertainment and Lifestyle, Hindustan Times, the question of marriage and settling down came.

Adding to this, Ananya Panday opened up about marriage and relationships at the HTLS 2026. (Getty Images via AFP) Ananya addresses GenZ’s reluctance to getting married During the conversation, it was noted that female actors today do not shy away from discussing their personal lives and relationships, unlike their counterparts in the 70s and 80s. But while actors are more open to marriage during the peak of their careers, youngsters outside cinema seem reluctant to settle down early. Ananya responded, “I think the reluctance could have been there in the past too; people just didn't have the choice to say no. Now, this generation is seeing enough examples to stand up and say no. For me, it is tough to answer a question like this because I am a very romantic person. For me, love is everything, and I would love to get married eventually. At some point, I'd like to be married and have children. I see my friends around me are exactly the same.”

Meanwhile, Ananya shared that this generation has more options when it comes to love, but their idea of love remains the same as earlier. “I think now we just have a lot more options. But that doesn't change the fact that we don't believe in true love. We are also still seeking that,” she added.

Notably, Ananya was on stage with filmmaker Imtiaz Ali, who is known for his sensitive depiction of love on the big screen. Earlier in the conversation, Imtiaz had spoken about how the younger generation has a very old-school idea of love. Building on that, Ananya added, “As Imtiaz sir shared, we have this very nostalgic feeling of love that we probably haven't experienced. So, our standards of love are also very high. We are not going to settle for just anything.”

As per the latest buzz, Ananya had only one rollout in 2026 - the romantic drama Chand Mera Dil, co-starring Lakshya. The movie received mixed-to-positive reviews but could not work wonders at the ticket-window. Ananya will next be seen in the second season of her successful Amazon Prime Video show, Call Me Bae .

In further updates, Created by Ishita Moitra, the show stars Ananya in the titular role, while Shruti Haasan joins the cast for season 2. The ensemble also includes Vir Das, Gurfateh Pirzada, Varun Sood, Vihaan Samat, Muskkaan Jaferi, Niharika Lyra Dutt, Lisa Mishra, and Mini Mathur. Call Me Bae season 2 premieres on Prime Video on December 17.

On top of that, Abhimanyu Mathur is Deputy Editor, Entertainment at Hindustan Times. With almost 15 years of experience in writing about everything from films and TV shows to cricket matches and elections, he inhales and exhales pop culture and news. Currently, he watches movies and TV shows and talks to celebrities for a living, while occasionally writing about them as well. A journalism graduate of Delhi College of Arts and Commerce, Delhi University, Abhimanyu began his career with Hindustan Times at the age of 20, swapping classrooms for newsrooms at an early age. He began his journey in the early days of digital journalism, later switching to the madness of print journalism. Work has led him to far off places like Japan and Jordan, as well as to the interiors of Haryana and the Indo-Pak border. He dabbled in city reporting in places like Meerut, Gurgaon, and Delhi, covered the Olympics and Cricket World Cups, before finding his calling in entertainment and lifestyle during the pandemic. A Rotten Tomatoes Certified Movie Critic, he is equally at home covering stories on ground as he is interviewing celebrities and studios, and sometimes prefers to shepherd teams in delivering traffic through the day. Even as his role has evolved from reporter to supervisor over the years, his first love remains writing (and of late, talking on camera). With a good understanding of cinema and its trends, and a keen eye for detail, he continues to spark conversations around showbiz for readers around the world. Read More

title: Aditya Dhar recalls 20-year journey to becoming an 'overnight sensation' with Dhurandhar, credits wife Yami Gautam for changing his fate
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Filmmaker Aditya Dhar rose to widespread fame with his Dhurandhar films , which rollout late last year and in March 2026. At a recent awards event, the filmmaker spoke about his journey in the movie industry and revealed how he feels Yami Gautam 's entry into his life changed his destiny, calling her the lady luck of his life.

Adding to this, Aditya Dhar says Yami Gautam is his Lady Luck. Aditya Dhar credits wife Yami Gautam for changing his fate Yami and Aditya were honoured at the CNN-News18 Indian of the Year 2026 awards, where Aditya credited his wife for bringing good fortune into his life. The filmmaker shared, "I can only say that it took me 20 years to become an overnight sensation. So, it’s been quite a hell of a journey. And the graph has been quite an exciting one. I’m really, really thankful that I’m married to one of the most beautiful human beings I have ever met. My fate changed the moment she entered my life. And I feel that it’s all the lady luck which is helping me tell the Bharat story to the world."

Meanwhile, Yami also spoke about Aditya’s commitment to his craft, recalling how he would spend nearly 70 hours on set without sleeping, completely immersed in bringing his vision to life. She added that taking on such ambitious projects demanded immense courage and the conviction to see them through.
Notably, Aditya and Yami tied the knot in an intimate ceremony in Himachal Pradesh on June 4, 2021. The couple welcomed their son, Vedavid, in May 2024.

As per the latest buzz, Aditya moved to Mumbai in 2006 to pursue a career in filmmaking. He initially worked as an assistant director while also exploring lyric writing and screenwriting. Before making his directorial debut, Aditya worked as a lyricist and screenwriter, contributing to films such as Aakrosh (2010) and Tezz (2012). He also worked on the dialogues and screenplay of Kabul Express (2006).

In further updates, His major breakthrough came with Uri: The Surgical Strike in 2019, starring Vicky Kaushal. Based on the 2016 Indian Army surgical strike, the movie marked Aditya's directorial debut and became a major commercial success, collecting ₹ 341 crore rupees worldwide. It won him the National Movie Award for Best Director, while Vicky Kaushal received the National Movie Award for Best Star.

On top of that, Following the success of Uri, Aditya co-founded the production house B62 Studios with his brother Lokesh Dhar in 2019. He went on to write and produce projects such as Article 370 (2024), which starred his wife, Yami Gautam, and was directed by Aditya Suhas Jambhale. He also co-wrote and co-produced Dhoom Dhaam (2025) and worked on Baramulla (2025).

After a gap of nearly seven years as a director, Aditya returned with Dhurandhar in 2025, starring Ranveer Singh. The movie marked another major milestone in his career, establishing him as a filmmaker capable of mounting large-scale commercial entertainers and turning him into an overnight sensation. It broke several box-office records and collected over ₹ 1,300 crore rupees worldwide. His next rollout, Dhurandhar: The Revenge, became the first Indian movie to collect ₹ 1,000 crore rupees at the domestic ticket-window.

title: After minting ₹90 crore at the box office, Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia's The Vvaan arrives on OTT
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

After enjoying a good run at the ticket-window, crossing ₹ 90 crore rupees in worldwide gross, Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia's fantasy mystery drama, The Vvaan : Force of the Forest has now made its way to OTT. The movie began streaming on Prime Video on Friday.

Adding to this, The Vvaan had a good run at the ticket-window. The Vvaan releases on OTT Directed by Deepak Kumar Mishra, the movie's story is rooted in Indian folklore, where an age-old belief, a sacred forest and one man's reckless defiance ignite a ferocious supernatural battle. The official Instagram handle of Prime Video shared the update, writing, "The forest is now calling for you 🌳 #TheVvaanOnPrime, Watch Now."
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by prime video IN (@primevideoin)

Notably, Speaking about the movie, director Deepak Kumar Mishra shared, “With The Vvaan, we wanted to tell a story that feels rooted in the soil it comes from. The story, written and produced by Arunabh Kumar, draws from his childhood experiences, and I am grateful to him for bringing this story to us and for the opportunity to collaborate in bringing it to life on screen. We’ve all grown up hearing stories about local folklore, beliefs, and places that were warned against venturing into. At its core, the movie is about respect for nature and the cost of ignoring that balance, told through a gripping story."
As per the latest buzz, He added, "Sidharth and Tamannaah brought so much conviction to their roles, and the entire cast and crew poured their hearts into making this world feel real."

In further updates, The movie follows Rishi (Sidharth ), who returns to his ancestral village with his wife, Mamta (Tamannaah), to sell his inherited land. However, a proposed road through a sacred forest, protected by the village deity Vandevi, draws him into a conflict between development and deeply rooted beliefs. While Mamta respects the villagers' traditions, Rishi, having lost his faith, dismisses their warnings, especially the one forbidding entry into the forest after sunset. But when he defies this age-old rule, a terrifying chain of events unfolds, drawing him into a world of unsettling mysteries and forces beyond his understanding.

On top of that, The movie is presented by Ektaa Kapoor's Balaji Telefilms Ltd. in association with TVF Motion Pictures Productions and produced under the banner of 11:11. It also stars Sunil Grover, Maniesh Paul, Shweta Tiwari and Anup Soni in pivotal roles.

Of late, on the occasion of Chhath Puja, Ektaa Kapoor revealed the movie's sequel, The Vvaan 2. The makers shared the update on social media, writing, "THE VVAAN ki kahaani abhi baaki hai (The Vvaan's story is still left)."

title: Ramayana's Lakshman, Ravie Dubey, is happy to see his line ‘tut gaya toh tut gaya’ turn into a meme, says it makes him smile
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Television star Ravie Dubey made his grand theatrical debut with Ramayana . His performance as Lakshman in the movie won praise from critics as well as audiences. One of his lines from the movie has become meme material on social media, and Ravie is more than happy about it.

Adding to this, Ravie Dubey essays the role of Lakshman in Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana. Ravie Dubey on his Ramayana line becoming a meme In Ramayana: Part 1, Ravie's Lakshman says, "Tut Gaya Toh Tut Gaya (If it broke, so be it)" when Lord Parshuram gets angry and questions Lord Rama for breaking Lord Shiva's Dhanush during the Swayamvar. The line sparked a meme fest on social media.

Meanwhile, Reacting to the virality of the line, Ravie Dubey told Zoom in an interview, "I honestly had no idea it would travel this far. Sargun gets so happy seeing the memes, and what people are doing with that line really does bring a smile to my face. What makes me especially happy is that young people are finding their own way into Ramayana. For someone, it might be a line they laugh at and send to a friend. For someone else, it might be a scene that moves them. I'm happy about every way in."
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Ravgun kaur ❤️ (@sr_raviidubey)

As per the latest buzz, Apart from his line becoming a meme, the star has also found a new fan base in Thailand. Thai followers have been celebrating his performance, sharing video edits of him on social media and even giving him an affectionate new name, ‘P'Ravie’. Talking about this, he shared, "I kept seeing the name Phra Lak. I looked it up and realised that's what Shri Lakshman is called in the Ramakien. I didn't know that, and it was such a lovely thing to discover through the people who were writing to me. The love has been enormous, and I'm deeply grateful for it."

In further updates, Helmed by Nitesh Tiwari and backed by Yash and Namit Malhotra, the movie is a two-part epic mounted on a massive budget of ₹ 4,000 crore rupees. This makes it one of the most expensive and ambitious films in Indian cinema. Apart from Ranbir Kapoor, Ravie Dubey, Yash and Sai Pallavi in the lead roles, the movie also features Arun Govil, Lara Dutta, Kajal Aggarwal, Adinath Kothare, Sheeba Chaddha, Indira Krishnan, Rakul Preet Singh and Vivek Oberoi, among others, in key roles.

On top of that, In just 15 days, the movie has crossed ₹ 1,500 crore rupees worldwide, surpassing the lifetime collections of blockbusters such as KGF: Chapter 2, Pathaan, Jawan, Kalki 2898 AD and Dhurandhar. Domestically, the movie has collected over ₹ 860 crore rupees and continues to attract audiences to theatres.

title: Mahabharat's Lord Krishna, Nitish Bharadwaj, calls Ramayana an ‘agenda film’, slams Ravana's portrayal as a hero
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Mahabharat star Nitish Bharadwaj has strongly criticised Nitesh Tiwari 's Ramayana. While the movie received largely positive reviews from critics, Nitish called out the makers for portraying Ravana as an exceptionally liberal, socially just and fair ruler, arguing that this undermines the very purpose of Lord Vishnu's avatar. He further shared that the movie "seems like an agenda movie".

Adding to this, Nitish Bharadwaj calls Ramayana an agenda movie. Nitish Bharadwaj criticises Ramayana Nitish, best known for playing Lord Krishna in BR Chopra's Mahabharat, had earlier lauded the trailer of Ramayana and predicted international success for the movie. However, the final product has disappointed him. In an interview with NDTV, Nitish objected to Lord Rama's portrayal and shared, "Lord Ram has been brought down to a minuscule, normal human being who has a deadpan face. That's not Ram. Lord Ram is about maryada."
Meanwhile, He added that the portrayal of Ram leaving Ayodhya in tears fails to reflect the Ikshvaku clan's code of honour.

Notably, Nitish further criticised the movie for showing Ravana as a hero and shared, "Ravana's negatives were not shown at all. His character comes across like a Marxist communist leader. This weakling that you showed as Lord Ram is going to kill Ravan. You are making a hero out of a villain and a villain out of a hero."

As per the latest buzz, He further argued that the younger generation, which "does not read", could spend the next two years admiring Ravana as a "cool dude". He questioned how the makers would then portray Ram defeating Ravana in Part 2. Nitish also claimed that money had come into the production company from Luxembourg, the UAE and Singapore. He compared what he described as "agenda people" to "the new British", alleging that cinema was being used to diminish Indian civilisation. He urged the government to "do the money trail" into the movie's funding.

In further updates, Nitish Bhardwaj is not the only one to criticise the movie for allegedly 'distorting facts'. Mukesh Khanna, Sunil Lahri and others have also raised objections, particularly to Sai Pallavi's portrayal of Sita as a warrior.

On top of that, Before its rollout, Ramayana: Part 1 faced criticism over Ranbir Kapoor's casting as Lord Rama and its visual effects. However, audience perception changed after the movie hit theatres. It subsequently faced criticism over Sita's portrayal as a warrior wielding a sword and fighting monsters. Despite the criticism, the movie has crossed ₹ 860 crore rupees at the domestic ticket-window and ₹ 1,500 crore rupees worldwide. It has also surpassed the lifetime collections of films such as Dhurandhar, Kalki 2898 AD, Jawan, Pathaan and KGF: Chapter 2.

Apart from Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana and Ravi Dubey as Lakshman, the movie also stars Rakul Preet Singh, Arun Govil, Lara Dutta and Sheeba Chaddha in key roles. The movie has broken several box-office records and continues its strong run in theatres.

title: Sharad Kapoor says Josh co-star Shah Rukh Khan called him after his emotional appeal for work, reveals plan to meet Aryan Khan
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Josh-fame star Sharad Kapoor of late grabbed headlines after a video of him parting ways with his dogs went widely shared on social media. The star later shared a video appealing for work, following which several actors, including Sonu Sood, Salman Khan and others, came forward to support him during a difficult time. Now, Sharad has opened up that his Josh co-star Shah Rukh Khan has also extended his support.

Adding to this, Josh star Sharad Kapoor reveals Shah Rukh Khan called him after his widely shared video on work appeal. Shah Rukh Khan extends support to Josh co-star Sharad Kapoor In a recent chat with Navbharat Times, Sharad opened up that Shah Rukh called him after his appeal for work went widely shared on social media. The star shared, "Shah Rukh Khan shared do whatever you like and wish to do; I am ready to help you. I will be meeting Aryan Khan soon."

Meanwhile, He then recalled his fond memories of working with Shah Rukh during the shoot of Josh and shared, "We had a great bond; whenever he got stuck on some dialogue, I helped him, even if the scene was against me, because I wanted to make a good movie. And Shah Rukh is a confident star, bahut bada aadmi hai woh (he is a man of great stature)."

Notably, In the same interview, Sharad opened up that Sonu Sood had arranged a team of doctors and medical facilities to treat his leg injury. He added that he would be travelling to Karjat for treatment. Earlier, the All Indian Cine Workers Association had also lauded Salman and Sonu for helping Sharad during a difficult phase in his life.

As per the latest buzz, A video of Sharad parting ways with his four pet dogs surfaced online last week, raising concerns about his health and living conditions. The star later took to social media and shared a video revealing that he had been battling depression and had also suffered a leg injury.

In further updates, He appealed to senior actors, filmmakers and members of the movie fraternity to help him find acting opportunities. He shared he had been through a difficult period and wanted to start working again. He also spoke about how allegations against him had affected his mental health.

On top of that, He shared, "I want to appeal to CINTAA that I am looking for good work. And I need your support, and I know you have always supported people around you. A little bit of moral support is also enough for me."
He added, "I am a great star and you know that. Money is not the issue. The only issue is I am just looking forward to start work again."

title: Saif Ali Khan receives death threat in the name of Baba Siddique's alleged killers; police launch investigation
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Saif Ali Khan has become the latest high-profile individual from Hindi cinema to receive a death threat, the Mumbai Police verified on Thursday. The star allegedly received a threat in the name of Zeeshan Akhtar, a wanted accused in the murder of politician Baba Siddique . Police have launched an investigation.

Adding to this, Saif Ali Khan has received an alleged threat to his life. Saif Ali Khan receives threat The Mumbai Police told news agency PTI on Thursday that they have started an investigation into the alleged death threat received by Saif and are verifying its authenticity. “Star Saif Ali Khan received a voice message on his phone in the name of Zeeshan Akhtar, stating that he would meet the same fate as Baba Siddique,” a police official was quoted as saying.

Meanwhile, The report added that police are currently investigating whether the threat genuinely originated from Akhtar or someone else is impersonating him and using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to harass celebrities.

Notably, In October 2024, Nationalist Congress Party (NCP) leader and former Maharashtra minister Baba Siddique was shot dead by three assailants outside his son Zeeshan Siddique's office in Mumbai's Bandra East area.

As per the latest buzz, The alleged threat to Saif's life is the latest in a series of threats made to movie stars, including Amitabh Bachchan , Ayushmann Khurrana and Tusshar Kapoor, in recent weeks. Alongside the personal threats to actors, superstar Amitabh Bachchan's Juhu residence, Jalsa, was repeatedly named in a series of hoax bomb warnings sent to authorities in Mumbai and Pune over the past month.

In further updates, In October, an email sent to Mumbai Mayor Ritu Tawde and Deputy Mayor Sanjay Ghadi warned off an attack on Amitabh's bungalow and singer Diljit Dosanjh's concert at the Mahalaxmi Racecourse on November 27. Following this, Amitabh Bachchan conducted his weekly meet and greet with followers cased in bulletproof glass.

On top of that, The Mumbai Police of late cracked the case involving threats to movie stars like Ayushmann Khurrana and Tusshar Kapoor, concluding that a Bengaluru-based IIT graduate with no link to any gang was behind them. The police arrested 30-year-old Vaibhav Mishra, saying he used AI to issue threats. His motive remains unclear.

This is not the first time Saif has been in the news this year in connection to a threat to his life. In January, the star was stabbed by an intruder inside his home in Bandra. Saif, 55, was hospitalised and had to undergo surgery to remove the knife fragments from his body. The accused was arrested by the Mumbai police after a few days.

title: Sameera Reddy says South cinema gave her far more respect, money and stardom than Bollywood | Interview
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Sameera Reddy stepped away from films for several years to focus on raising her two children in Goa. She of late made her comeback with Sanjay Dutt's Aakhri Sawal , but thanks to her candid and relatable presence on social media, it feels like she has never really been away.

Adding to this, Sameera Reddy fondly remembered her stint in South Indian cinema. In a conversation with Hindustan Times, the star opened up about returning to films and how Sanjay accommodated her schedule, allowing her to shoot over weekends so she could be with her children during the week. She also shared her take on the debate around working hours for new mothers, and reflected on why her experience in South Indian cinema has been far more rewarding than her stint in Bollywood. Read on:

Meanwhile, It was wonderful. Having done two or three films with Sanjay earlier, reuniting felt very comfortable. Sanjay also produced this movie and he was extremely sweet. The main reason I haven’t done feature films or OTT projects over the past few years is that I am a very hands-on mother living in Goa. My life from morning to night revolves around my kids, and I found it very hard to leave them for weeks to shoot on set. But Sanjay accommodated me by suggesting, “Just come and shoot on the weekends.” Because of that arrangement, I shot every weekend over two to three months and loved every bit of it.

Notably, When I shot for Sanjay’s movie, I shot continuously and didn’t mind the long hours or extra shifts at all because I wanted to finish the work efficiently for my producer, especially since I don’t live in Mumbai. But I have done extra shifts when the need of the hour.

As per the latest buzz, That being shared, being a new mother comes with immense pressure — managing breastfeeding, hormonal changes and work simultaneously is not easy. If a producer can adjust and accommodate that star...it is a two way street. But if it doesn't work for the producer than everybody has to understand it. Looking at it from a producer’s perspective, massive daily financial investments are riding on a movie set, and delays can be very costly.

In further updates, Both sides of the situation need to be recognized and respected. While I cannot comment directly on Deepika Padukone’s specific stance, but I understand, she is an amazing star and if that was she needs, that is what she needs. But you can't have a one-sided view on this.

On top of that, To be completely honest, I had a superb experience in South Indian cinema. I worked with top stars including Chiranjeevi, Jr NTR, Suriya, Ajith, and Mohanlal, and my personal experiences were wonderful. Everyone’s journey is different, but for me, my Southern movie experience was way above my experience in Bollywood.

The respect, artistic value, financial compensation, and stardom I received in the South far surpassed what I experienced in Hindi cinema. Even today, 18 years later, the love and respect I receive from my Southern followers is unprecedented. While a Bollywood fan might say, “Oh yeah, there was a Sameera Reddy,” followers in the South still greet me warmly, saying, “We love you. You are our Meghna from Vaaranam Aayiram!” I will always hold the softest corner in my heart for my South Indian films, and in my mind, I will always consider myself a South Indian star first.

The three apartments also come with a total of nine dedicated car parking spaces, with three allotted to each unit.

title: Mahaveer Jain announces epic musical drama Kabira on Sant Kabir; Abhishek Sharma to direct, Tanishk Bagchi to compose
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Set in 15th-century Kashi, the movie will explore the mystic poet’s life, philosophy and challenge to religious and social divisions.

Adding to this, Set against the backdrop of 15th-century Kashi, Kabira will trace the life of a figure whose philosophy centred on humanity and spiritual unity. Born to a Hindu mother and raised by a Muslim weaver family, Kabir's journey was shaped by his position outside the established religious structures of his time. His life and poetry questioned divisions between communities, with his teachings continuing to find relevance across generations.

Meanwhile, The movie will be directed by Abhishek Sharma, known for helming projects such as Parmanu: The Story of Pokhran and Tere Bin Laden . With Kashi forming an important part of the narrative, the filmmaker will look to recreate the historical setting and bring the city's ghats and cultural atmosphere to the big screen.

Notably, Music will be a key element of the project, with composer Tanishk Bagchi developing its musical landscape. Kabir's celebrated dohas and spiritual philosophy will be reinterpreted through a blend of folk, Sufi and classical fusion sounds. The makers are positioning the movie as a musical experience that brings together the poet's timeless words and a contemporary cinematic presentation.

As per the latest buzz, Kabira is presented by Mahaveer Jain and Amit Upadhyay and produced by Mahaveer Jain Films (MJF), Saral Vallabh Bhansali and Shraddha Singh under the banner of A Shock and Awe Production.

In further updates, While the makers have not yet revealed details about the principal cast, the project is scheduled to go on floors in early 2027. With its focus on Kabir's life, social philosophy and poetry, the movie aims to bring a significant chapter of India's cultural and spiritual history to theatrical audiences.

title: MEGA EXCLUSIVE: Mumbai's iconic Gaiety-Galaxy FINALLY reopens after 74 days, just 4 days before its 54th anniversary; full film schedule for the week REVEALED
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

This big breaking news was verified to Bollywood Hungama by Digvijay Jinde, who runs the hugely popular YouTube channel Bollywood Premee. He told us, “The good news is that the theatre finally resumes operations from November 20. The plans for tomorrow have already been drawn and advance booking has begun.”

Adding to this, Digvijay was overjoyed and even had tears of happiness when he informed us about this development. And it's hardly surprising. After all, for countless moviegoers, the temporary shutdown of Gaiety-Galaxy was nothing short of a heartbreak. For them, G7 is not just another cinema complex. It is a part of Mumbai's cinematic history, a place where films are not merely watched but truly celebrated.

Meanwhile, Digvijay also shared with us the list of films that will be screened at G7 from November 20. The biggest auditorium, Gaiety, will screen Ramayana at 1:00 pm, 5:00 pm and 9:15 pm. Galaxy will play the Hindi version of OM: Operation Mole at 11:45 am, 3:00 pm, 6:15 pm and 9:30 pm. In Gemini, Rajini: The Jailer 2 will be screened at 12:00 pm, 3:15 pm, 6:30 pm and 9:45 pm.
Notably, In the 100-seater Gossip, Kaali Kheti is scheduled for 12:45 pm, while Drishyam The Conclusion will be shown at 3:45 pm, 6:45 pm and 9:45 pm.

As per the latest buzz, In Gem, Nanhe Dil , Jijai (Marathi flick), Kaali Kheti, Obsess and Udta Teer will be screened at 12:30 pm, 2:45 pm, 5:00 pm, 7:15 pm and 10:00 pm, respectively. Finally, in Glamour, The Vvaan will be screened at 12:15 pm, followed by Bandhu (Marathi flick) at 3:00 pm, Maitreyaa (Marathi flick) at 6:15 pm and Party Animals at 9:30 pm.

In further updates, Gaiety-Galaxy's closure lasted a staggering 74 days, and one can only imagine the financial losses suffered by the management during this period. Bollywood Hungama had earlier reported that despite the shutdown, executive director Manoj Desai continued to pay salaries to the employees, ensuring that they did not suffer financially due to the closure.

On top of that, Interestingly, Gaiety-Galaxy was inaugurated on November 24, 1972. In other words, the legendary cinema complex is reopening just four days before its 54th anniversary. For a theatre that has witnessed some of the biggest celebrations in Hindi cinema over more than five decades, the timing couldn't have been more special.

title: Ramayana box office collection day 15: Yash has a new winner in hand as film with Ranbir Kapoor takes over KGF Chapter 2 haul at ₹861 crore
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana: Part 1 was rolled out in theatres on November 5 to mixed reviews but has performed exceptionally well at the ticket-window. The movie starring Ranbir Kapoor , Sai Pallavi and Yash has now overtaken the lifetime collections of the Kannada star’s previous biggest hit, KGF: Chapter 2. The movie has crossed the ₹ 860 crore rupees mark in India alone.

Adding to this, Yash plays Ravana in Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana Part 1. Ramayana ticket-window earnings The trade website Sacnilk reported a collection of ₹ 16.72 crore rupees net in India for Ramayana on Thursday, taking its domestic total to ₹ 861.12 crore rupees. This means that the movie based on the Indian epic has surpassed the lifetime haul of Yash’s previous smash hit, KGF: Chapter 2, which stands at ₹ 859.70 crore rupees.

Meanwhile, Ramayana collected ₹ 564.50 crore rupees in net ticket-window in India in its first week. It collected ₹ 48.10 crore rupees on its second Friday, and ₹ 72.90 crore rupees and ₹ 75 crore rupees on Saturday and Sunday, respectively. On Monday, the movie brought in ₹ 32 crore rupees, with ₹ 28.60 crore rupees on Tuesday and ₹ 23.20 crore rupees on Wednesday. It has performed better in Hindi than the dubbed languages.

Notably, Ramayana has already surpassed the lifetime hauls of Aditya Dhar’s Ranveer Singh-starrer Dhurandhar , Laxman Utekar’s Vicky Kaushal-starrer Chhaava and more. It has films such as Dhurandhar: The Revenge, Pushpa 2: The Rule, Baahubali 2: The Conclusion and Dangal to contend with.
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by The World Of Ramayana (@worldoframayana)

In further updates, Ravi Dubey , who played Lakshman in Ramayana, penned a heartfelt note on the response to the movie. “On the morning of 5th November 2026, I woke up and felt something I’d forgotten the feeling of. I felt ‘seen’, and the love in it felt infinite. I think that’s all an star truly wants. That someone gives your work a chance. That something you felt while doing it reaches someone else, and they feel enough to tell you about it. What a gift that is. I’m still in disbelief as I write this. All I feel is gratitude,” he wrote on his Instagram account.

On top of that, Ramayana is directed by Nitesh Tiwari, who co-wrote the screenplay with Shridhar Raghavan, and produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash. It stars Ranbir as Rama, Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana. Kajal Aggarwal, Rakul Preet Singh, Vivek Oberoi, Kunal Kapoor, Adinath Kothare, Arun Govil, Indira Krishnan, and Lara Dutta also star in it, with Anupam Kher voicing Jatayu. Part 2 of Ramayana was initially revealed to hit screens for Diwali 2027, but it has been postponed to 2028.
